dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 25, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Royals Outlast Tigers in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**

A dominant performance by Daniel Lynch IV led the Kansas City Royals to a 3-2 win over the Detroit Tigers. Lynch earned the win after allowing just two runs over six innings. Hao-Yu Lee was the top hitter for the Royals, crushing a two-run homer and collecting two hits. Nick Loftin also homered for Kansas City, while Carter Jensen and Salvador Perez each added a hit. For the Tigers, Riley Greene and Colt Keith had two hits apiece.

**Giants Blast Angels 9-2, Devers Shines**

The San Francisco Giants rode a strong performance from Robbie Ray to a 9-2 victory over the Los Angeles Angels. Ray pitched six scoreless innings, striking out five and allowing just two walks. Rafael Devers led the Giants' offense, going 3-for-4 with a homer and four RBIs. Logan O'Hoppe and Jose Siri each had two hits for the Angels. Mike Trout also had a hit, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Giants' strong outing.

**Toronto Blue Jays Shut Out Boston Red Sox 6-0**

The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the Boston Red Sox 6-0, behind a complete-game shutout from Dylan Cease. Cease struck out 12 batters and allowed just one hit over nine innings. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense, going 2-for-5 with a homer and three RBIs. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. also had a hit and an RBI for Toronto.

**Padres Take Down Marlins 7-2**

The San Diego Padres defeated the Miami Marlins 7-2, behind a strong outing from JP Sears. Sears pitched 3.1 scoreless innings, striking out three and allowing just one hit. Ty France led the Padres' offense, going 2-for-4 with three RBIs. Esteury Ruiz also had a hit and an RBI for San Diego.

**Yankees Edge Phillies 3-1**

The New York Yankees took down the Philadelphia Phillies 3-1, behind a strong outing from Ryan Weathers. Weathers pitched 5.2 scoreless innings, striking out seven and allowing just one run. Jasson Domínguez led the Yankees' offense, hitting a solo homer and collecting a hit.
